name: Coracode Triple Enzyme Exfoliating Gel With Green Tea | Facial Exfoliating Gel for Dead Skin & Skin Texture | 100g
description:
Refresh and refine your skincare routine with Coracode Triple Enzyme Exfoliating Gel With Green Tea 100g. This lightweight exfoliating gel is formulated with a combination of skincare ingredients including Green Tea Extract, Allantoin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ceramide 3, Glycolic Acid, Malic Acid, Citric Acid, and Lactic Acid to support a smoother and refreshed-feeling complexion. The gel is designed to be applied to clean, dry skin and gently massaged in circular motions to help remove surface buildup and dead skin cells. Its convenient rinse-off formula makes it easy to incorporate into a regular facial care routine.

Key Features
Facial Exfoliating Gel – Designed to help exfoliate the skin and remove surface dead skin cells.
Green Tea Extract – Contains Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract as part of the formulation.
AHA Blend – Formulated with Glycolic Acid, Lactic Acid, Malic Acid, and Citric Acid.
Hydrating Ingredients – Contains Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Trehalose, and Sodium Lactate.
Skin-Conditioning Formula – Includes Allantoin, Panthenol, Ceramide 3, Squalane, Shea Butter, and Meadowfoam Seed Oil.
Gel Texture – Lightweight gel formula designed for convenient facial application.
Easy Rinse-Off Application – Massage gently and rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
Weekly Skincare Routine – Directions recommend using the product 1–2 times per week.

Product Specifications
Brand: Coracode
Product Name: Triple Enzyme Exfoliating Gel With Green Tea
Product Type: Facial Exfoliating Gel
Net Weight: 100g
Application Area: Face / skin
Formula Type: Gel
Usage: Exfoliation and facial skincare

How to Use
Step 1: Apply the gel evenly onto clean, dry skin. Avoid the eye and mouth areas.
Step 2: Gently massage in circular motions for 1–2 minutes.
Step 3: Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water and pat the skin dry with a towel.
Step 4: Follow with a moisturizer for best results.
Use 1–2 times per week as directed.

Safety Information
For external use only.
Avoid contact with the eyes and mouth.
Use according to the directions provided on the product packaging.
Do not overuse the exfoliating gel; the provided directions recommend 1–2 applications per week.
If irritation or discomfort occurs, discontinue use.
Store in a suitable place away from excessive heat and direct sunlight.
